signature.description: Optional. The Ed25519 signature, in lowercase hex, over the manifest without this field, written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, no spaces, UTF-8).

signature_alg.description: Optional. The algorithm of the signature; named so that another one can be added later.

key_id.description: Optional. The first eight bytes of the SHA-512 of the public key that made the signature, in lowercase hex.

min_bootloader.description: Optional. The oldest bootloader version the artifact can be installed over.

target.description: Optional. The controller the artifact is built for (for example g474 or h745-cm7).
